project.name: AgentCity
project.tagline: The AI operating system for your PC

next_milestone.name: Vertical slice
next_milestone.summary: Electron shell, FastAPI sidecar, SQLite event ledger, offline planner, approval gate, artifact, cancellation, and restart recovery wired end to end.
exit_criteria: App launches and reports sidecar health with no provider configured
One mission creates a typed plan, requests approval, executes a deterministic local tool, and produces a verifier-approved artifact
Events persist before the UI consumes them and survive an app restart
Cancel stops an in-flight run and marks the mission cancelled
Automated tests cover the happy path, approval rejection, cancellation, and restart recovery
